plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN (Viptela) routers and controllers. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, and interface traffic, for vEdge/cEdge, vSmart, vManage and vBond (CISCO-SDWAN-OPER-SYSTEM-MIB, with legacy Viptela enterprise PEN 41916 fallback).
name: Router

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilisation of the SD-WAN device, computed as 100 - systemStatusCpuIdle. The device reports CPU idle as a string, which the collector converts to a number.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total memory of the SD-WAN device in bytes (systemStatusMemTotal, reported in KiB and multiplied by 1024 by the collector).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free memory of the SD-WAN device in bytes (systemStatusMemFree, reported in KiB and multiplied by 1024 by the collector).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used memory of the SD-WAN device in bytes (systemStatusMemUsed, reported in KiB and multiplied by 1024 by the collector).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilisation of the SD-WAN device, computed by the collector as systemStatusMemUsed / systemStatusMemTotal * 100. Sustained high usage may indicate memory pressure or leaks.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
